main.description: Get an author's private-tier posts that the requester is authorized to read, newest first. The ordering field is each post's `record.createdAt` (descending, ties broken by record key); a `createdAt` later than the time of indexing plus five minutes is clamped to that bound, and the view carries the clamped value. Requires auth by a ready community member. An unknown actor and an actor with no visible posts both return an empty feed with no cursor. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. A `following` audience is not resolved yet and is served to its author only, as is any other mode. A block record or a private block between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out; a block through a list does not.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (createdAt::rkey of the last returned item).
Present only when the page returned at least one item and more candidates remain.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
